neighbours.label: degree or extreme words in a noun phrase (maximum, most famous, preponderating)
fire: The lining reaches a maximum thickness of about twelve millimetres.
The most famous such area is still found in eastern Hungary.
The bridge can carry a maximum load of forty tonnes.
Her most famous novel was written in a single summer.
The engine runs at a maximum speed of 6000 revolutions per minute.
This is the most famous painting in the whole collection.
Each player may hold a maximum of seven cards.
The most famous resident of the town was a retired sea captain.
